integrity: All proofs and results are presented as mathematical claims with explicit assumptions. Computational checks were rerun from the public standalone files. Same-model review is not independent validation. Historical-priority searches cannot establish absolute novelty.
scientific_limitations: The order-truncation classification holds only for k<=n+2, for finite n-ary quasigroups with n+1 separately named coordinate sorts and a single graph relation; the n+3 intercalate construction disproves continued universal saturation but does not classify higher widths. No counting or operation symbols are allowed. Sample finite programs are not infinite proofs.
title: Sharp \(n+2\)-variable saturation and its first failure for Latin hypercubes
